Title: Chronologia sanctorum et aliorum virorum illustrium ac abbatum sacrae insulae Lerinensis, a domno Vincentio Barrali Salerno monacho Lerinensi in unum compilata, cum annotationibus
Creator: Vincentius Barralis Salernus, monk of Lerins
Publisher: Lyon: Pierre Rigaud, 1613
Publication Date: 1613 (title page, read directly: 'MDCXIII')
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1613); the archive.org record carries the Creative Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0 (creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/)
Language: lat
Source: archive.org item bub_gb_uSTTKSeII9sC, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-10 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (2,881,243) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1613, out of US copyright by date. SCAN QUALITY: second witness only; quote only after checking the passage against the scanned page. Poor OCR: long s throughout. Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: A Lerins monk's chronology of the island's saints and abbots to his own day, quoting charters, e.g. the synod of Antibes of 1058 at about OCR line 40911 and Aldebert in 1041 at about 40863.
